mapper.sql: id,tenant_id AS tenantId,message_id AS messageId,asset_index AS assetIndex,sdk_file_id AS sdkFileId,media_kind AS mediaKind,md5sum,file_size AS fileSize,file_name AS fileName,content_type AS contentType,status,object_key AS objectKey,content_sha256 AS contentSha256,actual_size AS actualSize,error_masked AS errorMasked,attempt_count AS attemptCount,next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt,lease_owner AS leaseOwner,lease_until AS leaseUntil,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_wecom_media_asset WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_wecom_media_asset WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_wecom_media_asset WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND message_id=#{messageId} ORDER BY asset_index
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM crm_wecom_media_asset WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','DOWNLOADING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=#{now})

SELECT FROM crm_wecom_media_asset WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=#{now})) OR (status='DOWNLOADING' AND lease_until<#{now})) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_media_asset SET status='DOWNLOADING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=#{now})) OR (status='DOWNLOADING' AND lease_until<#{now}))

UPDATE crm_wecom_media_asset SET status='STORED',object_key=#{objectKey},content_sha256=#{sha256},actual_size=#{actualSize},error_masked=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DOWNLOADING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE crm_wecom_media_asset SET status=#{status},error_masked=#{error},next_retry_at=#{nextRetryAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DOWNLOADING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
